source: campaign-outline.md 3.6 and D1 (0:30 recap, a different cut from ep5_opening's; then Torvald's and Ysolde's big intros); mission-e6-01.md ER8; prologue-3min.md 2; docs/design/script-episodes-4-8/e6m1.md
note: Episodes 4-8 script pass (2026-10-08): written from the spec's beats; shot list in docs/design/script-episodes-4-8/e6m1.md. No .cine yet. French: data/i18n/fr/story_e4_e8.po. To go live: move this file to data/voice/lines/ and its French into data/i18n/fr/dialogue.po.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Kings brought him their quarrels,|and went home as friends.
lines.text: Kings brought him their quarrels, and went home as friends.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Then, between one breath|and the next, he was gone.
lines.text: Then, between one breath and the next, he was gone.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Torvald, the eldest. Where he stands,|the ice holds, and so does the line.
lines.text: Torvald, the eldest. Where he stands, the ice holds, and so does the line.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Ysolde. I found her coaxing|a sapling through the frost.
lines.text: Ysolde. I found her coaxing a sapling through the frost.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: I know this tale well, child. I was that wizard.
lines.text: I know this tale well, child. I was that wizard.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Ysolde once asked me what I remember|of being young. I told her: snow.
lines.text: Ysolde once asked me what I remember of being young. I told her: snow.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: I was a boy on a mountain pass, keeping a|beacon for soldiers who had gone down the road.
lines.text: I was a boy on a mountain pass, keeping a beacon for soldiers who had gone down the road.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: They never came back.|I kept it lit all winter anyway.
lines.text: They never came back. I kept it lit all winter anyway.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: All winter? For men who were not coming?
lines.text: All winter? For men who were not coming?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Someone had to keep the light, I said.
lines.text: Someone had to keep the light, I said.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Then come with me.|I need someone who keeps a light.
lines.text: Then come with me. I need someone who keeps a light.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: He gave me the north. One winter, he gave|me a block of ice with a light inside it.
lines.text: He gave me the north. One winter, he gave me a block of ice with a light inside it.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Something came for it every winter,|for a hundred winters. Nothing got past me.
lines.text: Something came for it every winter, for a hundred winters. Nothing got past me.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: He said I wait too long.
lines.text: He said I wait too long.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Once a rider hammered at my gate,|and I stood there counting.
lines.text: Once a rider hammered at my gate, and I stood there counting.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: He called me his patience. Twelve years now,|I have waited for him to come back.
lines.text: He called me his patience. Twelve years now, I have waited for him to come back.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: You could stop waiting.
lines.text: You could stop waiting.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: No. It is the one thing I am good at.
lines.text: No. It is the one thing I am good at.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: You know how he found me. A girl, a sapling,|the frost. That part is easy to tell.
lines.text: You know how he found me. A girl, a sapling, the frost. That part is easy to tell.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: After that, for twenty years, he brought me|dead things. A frozen rose. A burnt branch.
lines.text: After that, for twenty years, he brought me dead things. A frozen rose. A burnt branch.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Every time, he said the same thing.
lines.text: Every time, he said the same thing.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Show me again.
lines.text: Show me again.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: He gave me the west and told me to keep it|growing. Nothing that grows stays beaten.
lines.text: He gave me the west and told me to keep it growing. Nothing that grows stays beaten.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: He said I would not take a side,|not even while the world burned.
lines.text: He said I would not take a side, not even while the world burned.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: He was right. For far too long.
lines.text: He was right. For far too long.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: He called me his heart. A heart is the|part that keeps going when the rest stops.
lines.text: He called me his heart. A heart is the part that keeps going when the rest stops.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: You never speak of the night he went.
lines.text: You never speak of the night he went.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: I promised not to. So did someone else.
lines.text: I promised not to. So did someone else.
